visual_elements.description: Grumpy Cat meme photo: white/gray cat with grumpy face sitting against a gray couch/blanket. White all-caps meme text overlaid: 'I LOVE MATH' at top and 'IT MAKES PEOPLE CRY!' at bottom. Overlaid object-detection-style bounding boxes: two red rectangles near the top (one left of center around the cat's ear area, one upper-right), one yellow rectangle around the cat's face, and two overlapping green rectangles at the mid-left edge. Image framed by a thin red border.

Photo of a small Yorkshire-Terrier-type dog lying in a dark brown round leather pet bed on a beige carpet, with a wall/door in the background. Overlaid detection bounding boxes: one red rectangle near the dog's head/ear (upper-left of dog), one yellow rectangle around the dog's face, two overlapping green rectangles at the right side of the bed. Image framed by a thin red border.

Rectangular text box with light-yellow fill and thin blue border containing three text lines: bold header 'Example: 30 different filters', then 'Each filter can detect different information from the image', then 'Apply those 30 filters on the image  (each one should be applied on the whole locations on the image)' (this last line wraps onto two lines in the box).
Small right-pointing block/chevron arrow, white fill with red outline, pointing from the text box toward the filter-grid image.
visual_elements.position: between text box and filter-grid image, bottom center-right

visual_elements.description: Small square visualization showing a grid of approximately 6 columns x 6 rows (~36) tiny colorful patches, resembling learned CNN first-layer filter visualizations; patches include diagonal stripe and blob patterns in teal, blue, green, red, orange, purple, pink, gray and multicolor combinations. Framed by a thin red border.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E9E9E9). 2. Draw a no-fill rectangle with a ~2pt red (#C00000) outline inset ~5% from all slide edges as the outer frame. 3. Add title text box centered at top: 'How many filters we should apply', Arial bold ~34pt, color #C00000. 4. Insert the Grumpy Cat meme image (cat on gray couch, white captions 'I LOVE MATH' top and 'IT MAKES PEOPLE CRY!' bottom) at upper-left (~10-42% width, ~28-60% height); add a 1.5pt red border; overlay two red rectangles near the top, one yellow rectangle on the cat's face, and two overlapping green rectangles at mid-left. 5. Insert the dog-in-leather-bed photo at upper-right (~45-77% width, same vertical band); add 1.5pt red border; overlay one red rectangle near the dog's head, one yellow rectangle on its face, and two overlapping green rectangles at the right side. 6. Create a rectangle at bottom-left (~8-72% width, ~66-92% height) with light-yellow fill (#FFFFE1) and 1.5pt blue (#0000CC) border; inside, three paragraphs in dark navy (#000080), Arial ~18pt: bold 'Example: 30 different filters'; then 'Each filter can detect different information from the image'; then 'Apply those 30 filters on the image  (each one should be applied on the whole locations on the image)' (let it wrap to two lines). 7. Insert a small right-pointing block arrow (white fill, red outline) at ~70-75% width, ~80% height, pointing at the filter grid. 8. Insert the CNN-filter-grid montage image (≈6x6 colorful patches) at bottom-right (~76-93% width, ~64-92% height) with a 1.5pt red border. 9. Optionally add a solid black rectangle strip across the very bottom edge to mimic the video-player bar.
